ui.staff.view_tip: Switch generated notation without changing pitches or performed durations. The view is saved in the project.
ui.staff.original_tip: Keep the imported image and anchors intact. MusicXML, blank projects and generated scores can switch between numbered and staff notation.
ui.staff.track_help: Choose one monophonic part/staff/voice to practise. Tracks follow the source file; simultaneous notes are not flattened into a sequence.
ui.staff.imported: Imported the full staff score with %1 written notes. Play both hands together and save as JPP.
cli.staff_renderer_check: Verify staff layout, anchors and musical material preservation
cli.staff_workflow_check: Verify MusicXML import, staff view, playback and project reopening
cli.musicxml_check: Verify MusicXML tracks, exact timing and monophonic conversion
ui.staff.original_parts: Original staves play together; all written notes are retained, not generated accompaniment.
ui.staff.guide_only: This inspector is the practice cursor guide. Complete written parts are stored and played on the shared staff timeline.
ui.staff.numbered_remove_tip: To remove a false sounding note, change its degree to rest (0). Deleting a timed column would change both hands' alignment.
ui.staff.numbered_unlinked_tip: This pitch belongs to the other hand or a chord tone. The upper-guide editor does not edit this pitch; select a guide note to edit it.
messages.staff.performance_stale: Original parts no longer match the note timing. Reimport the complete score.
messages.staff.invalid_performance: Invalid staff performance fields or incomplete lead coverage.
messages.staff.invalid_performance_tie: Staff performance tie endpoints do not match.
messages.staff.performance_limit: Staff performance expansion exceeds its bounded limit.
cli.staff_playback_check: Verify synchronized staves, independent mute and PCM output
ui.staff.full_subtitle: Staff notation / %1 written notes · Click either staff; both hands share one clock
ui.staff.preserved_performance: Original staff playback preserves pitch, timing and each note's velocity. Instruments can be changed independently. Uniform velocity and automatic accents apply only to ordinary practice projects.
